evidence_snippets: A failover occurs when you perform the following tasks: Scale your instance Upgrade the Redis version of an instance Initiate a manual failover Perform a maintenance update If you implement retry logic in your application to handle connection drops because of failovers, then your instance probably won't see a significant performance impact.
During a failover, if there are connections to the read endpoint, then Memorystore for Redis drops the connections to the replica that's being promoted to the primary instance.
